SIW cavity show resonance at four different frequency in X-band on excitation of higher order mode. This Higher order Cavity mode (TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">310</sub>) excitation is mainly responsible for achieving high gain. The design principle and simulated results for this slot antenna is presented in the form of reflection coefficient, isolation among the ports, gain of the antenna at the corresponding resonant frequency and radiation pattern. The isolation among all four ports is found to be good greater than 30 dB. From radiation pattern cross-polarization level is found to be around -20dB, the front-to-back ratio in all the frequency band is found to be about 15 dB.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition for Indian spoken languages towards Automated Home appliances
abstract: Home automation has been an interesting area of research that focuses on developing novel procedures and systems that brings technology into the hands of common people. Hands-free operational environments are becoming increasingly needful for physically challenged people. Specifically, the speech processing domain is significantly contributing to this specialized area where speech interfaces are built for operating different devices. The building of such systems introduces new challenges when systems are targeted towards low-resource languages. Even though there is an actual need in such languages, advancements in these languages are comparatively low. India is a country with diverse cultures with various spoken languages. It is really challenging to make spoken dialog systems for Indian languages since the availability of speech corpus is less. In this paper, we propose a speech recognition system for two spoken languages and implemented it for a home automation system.

articleTitle: Efficient Cryptographic protocol for Sorting with Data-oblivious
abstract: Sorting is a primitive operation in data processing. Multiparty sorting includes a set of players P and a list L. Each element a<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> ε L is shared among the players P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">J</sub> ε P (sharing is done over a prime field F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>). The players collaboratively execute the sorting without computing the values of the elements. The existing multiparty sorting protocols are based on compare, swap and data-oblivious with more time complexity. The existing compare protocol use either the bit-decomposition or bit-sharing and complexity of these protocols depends on size of prime. Since these protocols provide the privacy to individual elements, they need large computation. Here, we design a multiparty sorting protocol with privacy and data-obliviousness based on multiparty compare protocol. This proposed compare protocol does not use bit-decomposition or bit-sharing and complexity of this protocol depends on number of players. The proposed multiparty sorting protocol incurs constant number of multiparty message exchanges that depends only on the number of elements in the list. Ours multiparty sorting protocol sorting the elements with less time complexity.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of A Positive Output Voltage Dual Input DC-DC Converter
abstract: The concept of Multi-Input DC-DC (MIDC) converters have been proposed to conquer the demerits linked with the traditional methods of integration. A Positive Output Voltage Dual Input DC-DC converter (PODIC) that has the capabilities to surpass the demerits of conventional buck-boost converter topology with dual input, that has inverted output voltage is presented in this paper. This converter shall be operated in all the basic modes like buck-boost, boost and buck. A comprehensive explanation of various operating modes, derivation of the expression for the output voltage, and inductor status in all the three basic operating modes have been described in this paper. Also, the feasibility study of the converter is done with the support of simulation and experimental analysis. Efficiency analysis of PODIC is also done in all the modes to highlight the efficiency profile of PODIC.

articleTitle: Stack based location identification of malicious node in RPL attack using average power consumption
abstract: -Security is the main concern in wireless sensor network. Attack can be occurred in different ways in WSN depending upon the types of malicious activity through this research work we are identifying the location of malicious node using Stack based approach. Cooja simulator is used to implement the RPL attack and considering the Average Power Consumption as a bench mark for identifying the malicious activity. We have verified the impact of the attack by varying the number of malicious node and the network size. The Stack based approach for finding the location is novel one and simulation results shows the efficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: Minimisation of Ripples in Torque of Hysteresis Current Controlled PMSM using PI-RES Controller
abstract: This paper presents the minimization of ripples in torque of PMSM using proportional integral resonant controller. It is known PMSM is used wherever smooth torque is required. But because of some application of power electronics devices in the modelling often reveals the cogging torque that led to ripple in torque. The ripples in torque produces mechanical vibrations and noise in the machine that decreases the life of machine. The smoothness of torque is considered as the essential requirement for high performance of permanent magnet synchronous motors. For the better dynamic performance & minimum ripples in torque field oriented control(FOC) is implemented. The outer loop of FOC affect the performance of PMSM. PI controllers are generally preferred but this got affected by the variations in parameters, load condition and also on speed. To overcome this problem, resonant controller is introduced in accordance with PI for the minimization of ripples and to get the better performance. The performance of control methods of both PI & PI-RES controller is compared. The simulations are done in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Broadband Doherty Power Amplifier for 5G Communication System
abstract: This work reported a broadband Doherty power amplifier (DPA) with high power added efficiency that meets the requirements of modern 5G communication applications. The proposed DPA is designed by removing the offset line behind the main amplifier that leads to size compactness as well as wide bandwidth. The gallium nitride (GaN) device is chosen as the main and auxiliary amplifier for the designing process. The simulation results show that the peak power added efficiency (PAE) between 50-65% and PAE at 6dB backoff is between 35-52% from 3.3-4.2 GHz frequency band. Additionally, the saturated output power of 42-43.6 dBm and an average gain of 10.5 dB is achieved for 900 Mhz bandwidth. The value of inter modulation distortion (IMD3) is below 30dBc for the desired frequency band.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Epidemic Outbreaks Using Social Media Data
abstract: The COVID-19 has become the most dangerous disease for the 21st Century. The infectious disease had still gone through outbreaks despite modern medical treatments. The most recent example being the COVID-19 which has infected over 108 million people over the world and resulted in the death of over 2.3 million people as of 13 February 2021. During the ongoing pandemic of COVID-19 people are making use of social media to express their concerns as well as events related to the pandemic in their personal life. There are also a lot of agencies/organizations that are using social media platforms to convey status regarding the pandemic. We have used this overwhelming amount of data that is available on social media, particularly Twitter, to find out the trend of the COVID-19 pandemic so that we can prove the correlation between volumes of tweets tweeted related to the pandemic and daily confirmed cases which will indeed help in getting early warning regarding immediate future cases so that government and medical agencies can take appropriate measures to handle the upcoming situation. We have used natural language processing techniques and classification algorithms to classify the tweets related to the current pandemic and find the trend of the pandemic. We have used sentiment analysis techniques to find out how the current situation of the epidemic is i.e. is it getting worse or is it getting better? We have also created a live epidemic monitoring system to monitor the live tweets on a map-based UI which will show real-time tweets related to any epidemic/pandemic outbreak on a map in real-time.

articleTitle: Detection of Pulsars by Classical Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: This paper compares the classical machine learning algorithms to classify a pulsar (rapidly spinning neutron star) in the HTRU-2 dataset [6]. This dataset was gathered during the survey, called the High Time Resolution Universe (South), and is an imbalanced dataset consisting of more than 17 thousand records. Being highly imbalanced, several methodologies have been implemented (such as sampling, resampling, and feature selection) to overcome the imbalance between target classes (binary in this case) to achieve higher accuracies. The results of the proposed work show that by applying different methodologies, it is possible to overcome the class imbalance of the dataset, which in turn helps the classical machine learning algorithms to obtain promising accuracies.

articleTitle: EEG Data Acquisition System and Analysis of EEG Signals
abstract: The main objective of this manuscript is to perform an EEG Data Acquisition, Analysis and Present the EEG signals. It consists of innovative pre-processing method by utilizing amplifier with high impedance and high CMRR. It also consists of Analog filters to remove the noise and to prevent from Aliasing. Analysis is done through FFT algorithm using MATLAB. Findings of the frequency of the signals corresponding to peak magnitude are put forward as the Presentation of EEG signals. As the biomedical signals are having low frequency and low amplitude, the pre-processing, filtering, conversion are done with accuracy, requires adequate sampling rate, processing speed, gain, power consumption and size.

articleTitle: A VLSI Architecture and its FPGA Implementation for MIMO OFDM Channel Estimation
abstract: The multipath fading problem can be overcome by Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technique. However, combining OFDM technique with the multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems increase the spectral efficiency, improve link reliability and increases the data rates. In wireless communications the channels are sparse and hence the estimation of these channels can be made by using compressive sensing (CS) recovery algorithm. The orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) is one of the most well known CS recovery algorithms. This paper discusses MIMOOFDM channel estimation using OMP algorithm. The computational complexity of the OMP algorithm is very high and in order to accelerate the speed of the algorithm, VLSI architecture of OMP algorithm for estimating the MIMOOFDM channels has been designed and simulated using Xilinx 1S.2 Vivado HLX simulator.

articleTitle: Simulation and Steady State Analysis of SIMO Boost Converter for Electric Vehicles
abstract: Extreme environmental and human life issues such as global warming, air pollution and the rapid loss of oil resources in the planet are caused by the vast number of cars used. To overcome these issues traditional vehicles have been replaced by the Electric vehicles (EVs). To communicate the elements in the E-Vehicle DC-DC converters are used, by increasing or decreasing the input voltage levels. In order to efficiently reduce the quantity of electronic components to get different output voltages, Single-input Multiple-output DC-DC converters have been developed, also reduces cost. The SingleInput Multi-Output(SIMO) dc-dc converter delivers various levels of output voltage required by the load from a single source of dc input voltage. There are many SIMO topologies were evolved. In order to achieve the above limitations, in this project our work is to model a Single-Input Multiple-Outputs Boost converter. The suggested converter would uplift the voltage to a controllable middle voltage and high voltage dc output from a low voltage input power source. To validate the proposed topology for real time applications, the proposed converter is simulated in the MATLAB application.

articleTitle: Defected Ground Planar Antenna For GSM 1800/1900, LTE 46/47 and Wi-Fi 5 Wireless Applications
abstract: This work presents dual band planar antenna with defected ground structure (DGS) operating in Global System for Mobile (GSM) 1800/1900, Long Term Evolution (LTE) 46/47 and Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi) 5 frequency bands for wireless applications. The proposed antenna possesses back-to-back printing structure engraved on FR-4 substrate. The top printing structure carries two radiators namely Pi (π) and Omega (ω) which when deployed are interlocked and generates two resonances at 1.7 GHz and 5.2 GHz, while the back printing structure consist of inverted-T shaped as a DGS. The simulated analysis sights that the proposed planar antenna provides fractional impedance bandwidth of 15.89 % (1.68-1.97GHz) and 24.65 % (4.80-6.15GHz) centered at resonances 1.7 and 5.2 GHz, respectively. The achieved bandwidths support the proposed antenna to function smoothly in GSM 1800/1900, LTE 46/47 and Wi-Fi 5 frequency bands with gain and radiation efficiency more than 3dBi and 85%, respectively throughout the functioning bands. Therefore, because of multiband, miniaturized footprint and covering of essential GSM/LTE/Wi-Fi bands with good performances, the proposed antenna is a considerable contender for wireless applications.

articleTitle: A Novel Low-Cost Theft Detection System for Two Wheelers with Minimum Carbon Foot Print
abstract: This paper proposes a theft detection system capable of identifying fuel theft, ignition tampering, and vehicle lifting in two-wheelers. The system has GPS/GSM capabilities for real-time location tracking and SMS alerts. An old/unused android smartphone is installed inside the vehicle for providing these capabilities. It reduces the cost and carbon footprint of the system. Vehicle tampering is detected using a piezoelectric vibration sensor. An Atmega328 MCU is used to monitor the vibration sensor and the inbuilt fuel level sensor of the vehicle. The MCU can also control the alarm and the ignition system of the vehicle using relays. Two android applications are developed for the system. The first application acts as an interface between the MCU and the phone installed inside the vehicle. The phone generates SMS alerts and sends updates to an online database in response to the alert signals generated by the MCU. All theft reports are stored in a Google Firebase database. The second application is installed inside the user's phone. It allows the user to lock/unlock and track the vehicle. Finally, the system includes a user forum where users can post theft reports from the database and interact with other users of the application.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Cognitive Radio Techniques for Sensing Spectrum
abstract: In the communication engineering jargon, spectrum is a very precious and scarce resource. Hence every possible attempt is made to make the best efficient use of the existing spectrum. It has to be used in a very optimized manner, i.e the unused spectrum has to be detected and put in to use. One of the key objectives of cognitive radio is to sense the unused spectrum, so called as whitespaces. In order to sense the spectrum, several techniques are used. This paper focuses mainly on the different sensing methods like energy-based detection, matched filter, cyclostationary and results obtained by them.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison Among Hybrid NOMA Schemes Focusing on Outage Performance and Sum Rate Arrangement
abstract: The ever-growing number of users has brought about the challenge to identify a convenient technique for multiple access in next generation wireless communications. It has been seen that non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) technique provides far better performance than orthogonal multiple access (OMA) technique while taking advantage of the available resources. Interference can be minimized adequately through the use of Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) when implemented extensively. But massive implementation increases the complexity of the system and as a result energy efficiency is reduced. To counteract the disadvantages of NOMA technique, interest in hybrid NOMA techniques has grown. Many recent papers have suggested hybrid NOMA schemes as a viable option to mitigate the disadvantages of NOMA. This paper performs an analysis of the performance between hybrid NOMA techniques which are hybrid NOMA-OMA, NOMA Space shift keying (NOMA-SSK) and Successive user relaying cooperative NOMA (SR-NOMA). A comparison of all these techniques is conducted to identify the best hybrid NOMA technique for 5G and beyond wireless communication. The expressions for sum rate and outage probability have been derived for all the techniques. Through analysis and simulation results depicted that NOMA-SSK provides the best performance in terms of sum rate and outage probability among the discussed schemes.

articleTitle: Classification of Coronary Artery Disease Using Deep Neural Network with Dimension Reduction Technique
abstract: In this work, our purpose is for our proposed DNN models to classify the presence of Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with improved accuracy with selected components than in previous studies. CAD is one of the significant concerns among the population worldwide. The Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and Deep Neural Network (D.N.N.) methods co-operate and play a crucial role in identifying CAD diseases. The classification methods dependent on Deep Neural Network (D.N.N.), specifically Deep Belief Network (D.B.F.), H2OBinomial-Model-Deep Neural Network (H-DNN), and Dimensional Reduction Technique (D.R.T.) in particular Principal Component Analysis (P.C.A.) is most appropriate for issue solving. A model is robust with the joining of D.R.T. like P.C.A. This examination proposes an incorporated model of P.C.A. and D.B.F., H-DNN, for classification of CAD. The Model D.B.F., H-DNN, PCA-H-DNN, and PCA-DBF with subset components of CAD datasets give improved outcomes when contrasted with the D.B.F. and H-DNN. The PCA-H-DNN and PCA-DBF model gives a more right and accurate classification result.

articleTitle: Exploring Malicious Webpages Using Machine Learning Concept
abstract: Malicious web page identification emerges to be an unavoidable process in the digital era. With increase in usage of various digital devices with applications from lot of third party service providers, classification of a web page into a legitimate or malicious is a most demanding need of the day. The parameter considered for this classification is the URL of the webpage. The proposed solution uses TF-IDF score to do this task. This score would be incorporated with existing machine learning model such as linear regression and different classifiers and a comparative analysis will be made to choose the better one. In addition to these lists called white list could be maintained. The white list has the list of URLs, which has been classified as legitimate earlier. When a new URL is seen by the system, it would check for its availability in the white list. If the URL is not found it would be fed into our machine learning algorithm for classification. This work considers logistic regression along with comparison using random forest and support vector machine. The comparative analysis shows that, logistic regression seems to produce optimal results when compared with SVM and random forest algorithm in terms of identifying false rates. Also, from the analysis results it is observed that, Term Frequency Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) along with binary classifiers on white list works efficiently.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control of Three Area Interconnected Power System using Conventional PID, Fuzzy Logic and ANFIS Controllers
abstract: In this paper, control scheme for Load Frequency Control (LFC) problem in a three-area interconnected power system with Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) controller is presented. Its performance is compared with that of conventional PID Controller and Fuzzy Logic Controllers. This power system consisting of a single reheat thermal unit, a double reheat nuclear unit and a hydro unit. The controllers are designed, trained and tuned. The robustness test and performance of these control schemes against step load change is examine methodically, simulated and compared using Matlab-Simulink.

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Fault Location Detection Technique for High Voltage Transmission Lines
abstract: The exact pinpointing of faults is an essential aspect of the electrical network services. optimized location of faults will minimize downtime, enhance reliability, and be more cost-effective. Whenever a fault emerges, a disruption in the voltage and current is sent approximately at the speed of light in either trajectory. This disruption is known as the traveling wave, which may be utilized to pinpoint fault locations. The utilization of the traveling wave concept to pinpoint faults is becoming essential in attempts to improve precision. This paper presents a traveling wave algorithm centered on transmitted forward and backward electromagnetic waves induced when a fault appears in the transmission overhead line. The details found in the traveling surge can estimate the location where the fault emerged by measuring the initial traveling surgeon's periods of the two termination points of the line. The aim is to detect and pinpoint the fault's location utilizing the data collected of the electromagnetic waves produced by current traveling waves. The research is focused on the current and voltage signal analysis. The method has been designed using MATLAB/SIMULINK, where several case studies of the traveling wave fault location detection were analyzed.

articleTitle: Liquid Level Control of Quadruple Conical Tank System using Linear PI and Fuzzy PI Controllers
abstract: Design of multivariable control systems are in great demand in process industries. This paper focuses on maintaining the liquid level in a multivariable process, Quadruple Conical Tank System (QCTS). The mathematical model of the system is developed from the first principles. The mathematical model is linearized at an operating point for designing linear PI and fuzzy PI controllers. The linear PI controller is designed using the Ziegler - Nichols reaction curve tuning method. The parameters of the fuzzy PI controller are obtained using a genetic algorithm. Simulation results are obtained with linear PI and fuzzy PI controllers and they are compared.

articleTitle: Improvement in Semantic Address Matching using Natural Language Processing
abstract: Address matching is an important task for many businesses especially delivery and take out companies which help them to take out a certain address from their data warehouse. Existing solution uses similarity of strings, and edit distance algorithms to find out the similar addresses from the address database, but these algorithms could not work effectively with redundant, unstructured, or incomplete address data. This paper discuss semantic Address matching technique, by which we can find out a particular address from a list of possible addresses. We have also reviewed existing practices and their shortcoming. Semantic address matching is an essentially NLP task in the field of deep learning. Through this technique We have the ability to triumph the drawbacks of existing methods like redundant or abbreviated data problems. The solution uses the OCR on invoices to extract the address and create the data pool of addresses. Then this data is fed to the algorithm BM-25 for scoring the best matching entries. Then to observe the best result, this will pass through BERT for giving the best possible result from the similar queries. Our investigation exhibits that our methodology enormously improves both accuracy and review of cutting-edge technology existing techniques.

articleTitle: A New Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna for S-band, C-band and X-band Applications
abstract: This paper presents a frequency reconfigurable coplanar waveguide-fed antenna for S-band, C-band and X-band applications. Flexible Rogers RT/duroid 5880 is used in the design as a substrate with an area of 30 mm x28.4 mm and thickness 0.508 mm. A switch is placed on the surface of the antenna in order to alter the current distribution which in turn achieves tunable resonance frequency at ON and OFF state. The proposed design is simulated using CST MWS. The presented antenna is able to exhibit good radiation patterns with almost stable gain across the following mentioned frequency bands; 3.30-4.25 GHz (S-band) 6.10-7.47 GHz (C-band), 10.5-11.5 GHz (X-band).

articleTitle: A Novel Isolated DC-DC Multi-Level Flyback Converter for Multi-Level Inverter Application
abstract: The main theme of this paper is to present a high voltage gain dc-dc boost converter using flyback and multilevel concept. The proposed converter focuses on multilevel outputs with voltage multiplier cell. The input of the general dc-dc converters is either PV array or battery or fuel cell. The circuit is composed of diodes and capacitors which acts as voltage multiplier and also as a rectifier. The implemented multilevel flyback converter can be connected to an H-bridge forming a multilevel inverter. With the help of a single driven semiconductor switch namely MOSFET, the designed converter can produce a high voltage gain in continuous conduction mode. The proposed multilevel flyback converter has been simulated and verified with theoretical values. The results have been demonstrated in the report.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Several Fuzzy Controllers in AGC of Dual Area System with Time Delays
abstract: In this paper, performance evaluation of several fuzzy (F) based controllers such as FPI, FPID and fractional order (FO) fuzzy (F) PID (FOFPID) has been investigated for automatic generation control (AGC) study of dual area conventional power system. Analysis is executed by subjugating a step load change of 1% (SLP) on area-l and the system dynamics under various fuzzy controllers are compared to reveal the best. However, controller parameters have been rendered with a soft computing approach of seagull optimization algorithm (SOA). Moreover, the dual area conventional system performance is examined with and without considering the non-linearity constraints of communication time delays (CTDs) to bring out its substantial effect.

articleTitle: A Multipurpose Noise and Vibration Data Acquisition System using OTA Amplifiers and Filters
abstract: Due to the ease of gain selection and flexibility in frequency and Q-tuning, Operational Trans-conductance Amplifiers (OTAs) based amplifiers and filter banks are attractive signal conditioning options in many hardware applications like impact measurement and analysis. This paper has discussions on the design and development of a Data Acquisition (DAQ) System for the impact and vibration analysis on-board a vehicle. The DAQ System presented in this paper uses OTA based amplifier, filter, DACs and microcontroller. The gain value and filter cut-off frequencies can be optimally selected by the microcontroller via DACs. The design and development is already initiated.

articleTitle: Management of Battery using ANN Controller for Renewable Hybrid system
abstract: In current scenario, new researchers are focusing on alternative power sources other than already available ones. Government and local bodies are focusing on theses alternative renewable power plants which are cheap and readily available even in remote areas. The renewable solar and wind powers are extracted and are integrated. In this paper the integrated power of solar and wind energy hybrid power system is connected with variable DC motor load. To harness and utilize the power of solar and wind energy as per load demand an energy storage battery bank system is used for handling the surplus power generated. A strategical control of switching is done in such a manner as to route the excess power through battery bank for storage and utilizing it as per demand. The controlling approach for switching is created using fuzzy controller, PI controller etc. have been proposed by many researchers. This paper proposes an adaptive Control system with added intelligence for controlling the excessive power control. Looking to current scenario, more power producing sources, multiple battery bank can be connected to this integrated power system. This paper proposes Artificial Neural Network based controller. The training of the desired signal helps to reconfigure its adaptability in control system. The results obtained after training and handling of the surplus power through battery through simulation is labelled in the result section.

articleTitle: QnA System on Educational Textbooks: Digital Library Doubt Support System
abstract: The domain of content and knowledge on any particular topic of someone's interest is ever - growing. This broadening of the knowledge base of a subject combined with the easy accessibility to the Internet through various devices has resulted in easy access to the loads of content when a search related to the topic is made. But this gigantic collection of data also possesses a challenge. One needs to make some efforts to find the desired information. For this purpose, an individual might be required to go through a number of documents until he/she finds the answer that they craved for.This paper centers around a model to deal with this issue and helps in finding the relevant and precise answer to a query raised. To fulfill this purpose the model uses Natural Language Processing methods combined with knowledge graphs. The paper comes to a conclusion by presenting the performance of the model built.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Shadow Filter using CFCC
abstract: In this paper a new shadow filter implementation has been designed using Current Follower Current Conveyor (CFCC) block and grounded elements. Shadow filter allows for electronically tunable filter parameters by simply varying the gain of an external amplifier in the feedback path and without disturbing the core filter circuit. The shadow filter utilizes a CFCC block and three X+ Copy (X+<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</inf>) CFCC blocks and its parameters can be independently tuned with the gain of the external amplifier. The gain of this external amplifier depends on the ratio of two grounded resistors. The workability of the proposed filter has been demonstrated in PSPICE using 180nm TSMC CMOS technology node.

articleTitle: Comparision of Some Image Thresholding Techniques with Morphological Operations and Quantitative Evaluation for Lung Segmentation
abstract: Segmentation of lung parenchyma is a critical step on the computer aided diagnostic pipeline determining the success and failure of the overall system. Thresholding is one of the most frequently used operations carried out in most of the state of art methods for segmentation of lung parenchyma. This work presents a typical thresholding and morphological operation based lung segmentation framework, applies some of the variants of thresholding techniques, viz. fixed, histogram based, entropy based on 3D lung volume slice by slice and evaluates the quality of results obtained using five evaluation metrics and presents the results and discussion on the same.

articleTitle: Face Emotion Based Intelligent Chaterbot
abstract: Recognition of emotion is the detection of human feelings from facial expressions. Emotion recognition based on facial images has over the years been regarded as a challenging subject in the field of affective computing. Although there are several methods to solve this problem, due to their computational sophistication, they cannot be implemented on the embedded devices involved. We use three light and quantized deep learning models that can be deployed on embedded devices to address this problem. To obtain real-time output of emotion recognition, lightweight and quantized deep learning models are required. We use the model ensemble technique to improve accuracy, where we take the weighted fusion of two lightweight and quantized deep learning models so that they can be deployed with reduced computational complexity and improved accuracy on android devices. We were thus able to obtain real-time recognition of emotions on Android devices.

articleTitle: Optimal Shortest Path Selection by MSFO-SCNN for Dynamic Ring Routing Protocol in WSN
abstract: At remote location, the faster data delivery and conservation by scalable WSN is a challenging task since the human mediation is impossible. However, to meet the desired properties different technique have been evolved but some limitations are occurred like limited transmission range, high energy consumption and so on. Thus in this work we have developed ring routing protocol based on Modified Sailfish optimization (MSFO) and Shallow Convolution Neural Network (SCNN) (MSFO-SCNN) for dynamic network. In order to find the best path MSFO method is used and for training the optimized MSFO method, SCNN method is used. For choosing SCNN in MSFO is it have less number of complex network layer to train accurately. MATLAB platform is used to implement this work and the performance is taken in terms of end to end delay, lifetime of network, energy consumption, throughput, and latency.

Author Keywords: Modified Sailfish optimization Algorithm Ring Routing

articleTitle: Design of RF Non-Reciprocal Device Using Ferrite in Microwave Integrated Circuits
abstract: A ferrite-based four-port circulator is designed using two three-port circulators to operate at ultra-high frequency 3 GHz - 5 GHz. A ferrite disk of 1.5 mm thickness and 13.5 mm in diameter is incorporated into the circulator design. The internal magnetic field of 1380 Oersteds and saturation magnetization (4πM) of 3900 Gauss is applied onto the ferrite disk for anticlockwise oriented magnetic field rotation. Maximum isolation of 27.6 dB and insertion loss of 23.1 dB is obtained at 3.5 GHz, which lies in the 5G band of communication. Further, the parametric study is conducted to observe the variation in characteristics of a circulator.

articleTitle: A quantum mechanical study of Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistors (CNTFET) and parametric analysis of temperature variant control coefficients
abstract: The quantum mechanical study in this paper deals with the impacts of control coefficients on different parameters of Ballistic and Non-Ballistic conduction in CNTFET. Device parameters like current ratio, Drain Induced Barrier Lowering (DIBL) and transconductance are compared with respect to both gate control (α<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub>) and drain control (α<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>) coefficients under different temperatures for both the regimes. As these parameters influence the carrier transport inside the CNT channel, there is a variation in the current flow in the device. In order to compare the performance of CNTFET in both ballistic and non-ballistic conditions the optimum values for both the control coefficients are considered. The variation of dielectric constant was also taken in account which yielded almost 2 times increase in both Current ratio and Transconductance and almost no change in DIBL when the initial value of our observation is raised up to 3 times.

articleTitle: A Device Framework for IoT using Web Services
abstract: As IoT is making in-roads into field, many chip companies are incorporating IoT resources into processors. This allows development of IoT frameworks using which commercial devices can be integrated with web servers, reducing the overall time to market. We have implemented such a framework for IoT using Web services. The framework is based on Texas Instruments' CC3200 microcontroller and PHP + Apache 2.2 web server. The framework provides graphical interface to monitor and control IoT devices. The microcontroller supports Internet connection through WiFi routers as they come equipped with on-chip support for RF communications. Digital/analog input to the microcontroller will be sent to the server using a simple web service. This data is saved and accessed using various REST API and applications implemented on Apache-2 web server. APIs for HTML-5 and Android are available in this framework. The paper includes interaction of some hardware and software components which have to be integrated to achieve desired implementation and performance.

articleTitle: Modelling and Analysis of Two-Wheeled Self Balanced Robot
abstract: Two wheeled self-balancing robot finds several applications in real life as well as for testing the effectiveness of various control algorithms. This paper concentrates on the modelling of a two-wheel dynamic robot and control design. In addition, a controller known as the Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) is utilized for simulating the system's stabilization. The controller is robust enough to refuse system disturbances and noises. Through the Lagrange equation of the robot's broad co-ordinates, the mathematical model is established, which is then changed as a state spatial system. To determine system performance, Matlab simulation is used. The results of the simulation show that the method proposed stabilizes the system at the position and angle. Different graphs have been shown in the paper to illustrate how the simulation operates.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Dual loop controller for a single-phase 5-level Cascaded H-Bridge Inverter with Reduced THD
abstract: This paper aims to design and implement a dual loop controller based single phase 5-level Cascaded H bridge inverter using carrier based level shifted pulse width modulation scheme. A cascaded H bridge inverter not only provides multiple output voltage levels for lesser Total Harmonic Distortion, but also provides modularity. The control strategy consists of two feedback loops for better response and stability. It comprises an inner current loop and an outer voltage loop. Both the loops are controlled by PR controllers The inner current loop is controlled by a non-ideal PR controller whereas the outer voltage loop is controlled by an ideal PR controller. Steady state performance of this type of controller is much better than the conventional PI based controller. Designing the controller, filter and implementation of the inverter is carried out in simulation Using MATLAB code and Simulink.

articleTitle: Employing Sliding Mode Control on a Two-Phase Voltage Regulator Module
abstract: Voltage regulator modules (VRMs) regulate its output voltage with small ripple voltage even in the presence of high load currents. They also experience loading conditions of high frequencies that are brought about by running software. Conventional linear controllers such as PIDs have already been utilized to address this, however, such controllers depend on the accurate modeling of the system to be controlled. In this study, we present a non-linear controller to achieve VRM performance criteria by utilizing the sliding mode control (SMC) principle. The VRMs will employ SMC in both its voltage and current share loops. We derive the sliding mode coefficients of a fixed frequency sliding mode controller and evaluate its performance under 10% and full load static load conditions. Simulation results have shown that the SMC-controlled VRM can regulate its output voltage, share the load current equally between its two phases, and achieve a low output ripple voltage.

articleTitle: Detection of On-Off Keying Signals in Free Space Optics: A Supervised Learning Approach
abstract: In this paper, we present the problem of detection of on-off keying modulated signals in free space optical communication systems in fading channels influenced by weak, moderate, and strong atmospheric turbulence, using a supervised learning framework. The underlying hypothesis testing problems are modeled by lognormal, gamma-gamma, and exponential distributions, for the weak, moderate, and strong atmospheric turbulence-induced fading scenarios, respectively. In particular, we propose an extensive comparative study of supervised learning techniques such as logistic regression classifier, support vector machine, naive Bayes classifier, quadratic discriminant analysis, K-nearest neighbor, decision tree, random forest, AdaBoost, and multi-layer perceptron techniques in terms of bit error rate. With the help of Monte Carlo simulations, we show that the AdaBoost and multi-layer perceptron classifiers yield the best performance across all fading scenarios, while the decision tree and random forest classifiers provide a lower limit on the performance.

articleTitle: Modelling of Hydropower Plant
abstract: From leveraging big data to integrating smart solutions into a power plant it is a primitive requirement that a good, practical, and tangible model of the system exists to virtually integrate and simulate a given solution. MATLAB being a multifaceted software now-a-days, has different frameworks and libraries for implementing modern technologies like Artificial Intelligence but, also being a very old tool for power system analysis it gives engineers dexterity to integrate modern multidisciplinary solutions, swiftly and prudentially, in a single package. It expedites prototyping and also reduces cost. In the view aforementioned, we briefly reviewed and investigated, in this paper, some extant models in MATLAB/SIMULINK packages required for design and simulation of a Hydropower plant. At first, we introduced hydropower plants and various basic components required for its modelling. Then we went on to review the models underneath the hydraulic and the governor system (HTG), the excitation system and electromechanical dampening systems (power swing stabilizer) in the software. Then we investigated the powerplant model using different configurations of the excitation system, built with different electromechanical dampening (power swing stabilizer) systems available in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The resilience of the system is tested by introducing a three phase-ground fault at a certain time of its operation and also by tweaking the X/R ratio of the terminal source. Review and evaluation are made by analysing rotor speed characteristics, field(excitation) voltage characteristics and generated terminal voltage of synchronous machine under three different configurations.

articleTitle: Exploration of PFSCL in Subthreshold region of operation for use in ultra low power applications
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of digital logic using positive feedback source coupled logic (PFSCL) style operating in subthreshold region, for use in ultra low power applications. Subthreshold PFSCL (STPFSCL) divide-by-8 circuit has been designed and simulated using PTM 90nm CMOS technology and found to have PDP of 0.4pJ compared to a PDP of 2.96pJ for ST-CMOS. Further, in ST-PFSCL, the delay depends on the bias current and not on the power supply, thus providing added flexibility to the design of ultra low power applications. Implementation of ST-PFSCL gates has been explored through XOR2 using both traditional NOR based and stacked transistors in the pull down network, leading to multistage and single stage implementation respectively. The single stage implementation of ST-PFSCL XOR2 provides a PDP of 0.006pJ and an improvement by a factor of 8.33 in frequency of operation for a given power dissipation and a reduction in power dissipation by a factor of 7.5 for a given frequency of operation in comparison to ST-PFSCL NOR based implementation.

articleTitle: [Speakers - 4 abstracts]
abstract: Provides an abstract for each of the presentations and may include a brief professional biography of each presenter. The complete presentations were not made available for publication as part of the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: A Novel Compact Monopole Antenna with Staircase Shaped Ground Plane for UWB Applications
abstract: This paper proposes a compact monopole microstrip patch antenna with Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) characteristics. The antenna is printed on the FR4 substrate with dimensions 15x15x1.5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The radiating element is a modified circular patch fed using a microstrip feed line. A partial ground plane is connected to a stair case shaped parasitic element. The impedance bandwidth of the design is from 2.9 GHz to 12.2 GHz (fractional bandwidth of 123%). The evolutionary stages of the antenna along with a parametric study is presented. The design shows stable E and H Plane radiation patterns over a wide frequency range. The applications such as WLAN, WPAN, radar as well as satellite and military applications can be targeted using the designed antenna.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Dual Area Hydro Thermal System with the Integration of Plug in Electric Vehicles
abstract: In this paper, the stability of dual area conventional power system of hydro thermal units has been analyzed for a step load change of 1% SLP on area-I. Proportional (P)-integral (I)-double derivative (DD) (PIDD) controller optimized with hybridized algorithm of artificial electric field (HAEFA) is enacted as secondary regulator in both the areas. More over the efficacy of HAEFA based PIDD control approach has been revealed by comparing with other control techniques devoted in literature. Further, the dual area conventional system has been analyzed by considering the integration of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs). Analysis reveals the enhancement of power system performance under disturbed load conditions with PEVs integration.

articleTitle: DeepSight: Land Use and Land Cover Classification Using Satellite Images
abstract: Remote Sensing data is constantly on the rise with launches of various satellites around the world, generating a huge amount of data. This data is raw i.e. it lacks semantics. Due to the lack of semantics, this data is untapped. To fully utilize this data, we propose a classification method based on deep learning, deployed as a web service- DeepSight. DeepSight uses a convolutional neural network- SpectrumNet to effectively classify land use and land cover. After training the model over 27,000 images, an accuracy of 96.3% is achieved for the testing set whereas the validation set gives us an accuracy of 95.1%. Thus, the results show a fairly high accuracy rate of classifying the multi-spectral images and this can be further used by multiple domains requiring Remote Sensing data semantics relating to land use and land cover.

articleTitle: Assessing Industrial Readiness of Students by Leveraging Soft Skill Parameters
abstract: Bare minimum number of the graduates generated annually in the country are employable in their respective domains when assessed on the basis of various technical and psychometric parameters. The aim of this project is to help minimize the huge margin of mismatch by analysing and enhancing the soft skill parameters of the students through a series of questionnaires which are designed to assess 10 primitive and primary soft skill parameters: organizational skills, Leadership skills, Communication, Time Management, Team Work, Problem Solving, Self-Management, Decision Making, Self Confidence, Creativity; which are required to enhance their chances of getting a job of their domain and liking. These questionnaires are to be answered by the students which will be then classified by a pipeline model that outputs the potential of employability. The model will be trained on the data obtained from students who are already employed. Data mining is excellent for obtaining relations and patterns between data and helps in classification and comparison. Predicting the employability of students will help institutes and management take appropriate steps to help them improve. This will enhance the chances of students and individuals to secure a job with reputed organizations.

articleTitle: A Deep Dive on Business Intelligence Systems and Infrastructure using Cloud Environment
abstract: Business intelligence is a computer technology used to identify, obtain and analyze business data for example revenue, products, costs, sales revenue etc. However, this type of trajectory creates closed data that requires significant time to get an idea of everything the user needs. Despite its shortcomings Business Intelligence (BI) has been able to generate fast data that could take a long time to research, making it an ideal tool for tracking emerging markets and markets in the community. Business Intelligence (BI) is an umbrella term that combines software with the development of Information systems and makes available the required information for any company. Most agree that BI works by capturing, storing, understanding and analyzing unprocessed data and making information accessible to it to improve business performance.

articleTitle: Real-Time Thought Controlled Action for Paralytic Patient using Electroencephalogram
abstract: Brain computer interface is an assistive technology that tries to create a direct link between the brain and the environment. This possibly make one to aid paralytic patient which pose as a major challenge in fast technology growing world. This paper describes the method to capture the thoughts of a person using EEG and to perform automated actions according to the thoughts.

articleTitle: A Data Security module based on Crypto and Steganography techniques
abstract: Data security is one of such concern which cannot be avoided in today's world. Protecting the sensitive data and personal information from unauthorised access and preventing it from being misused is important and can be done using various password protected software or systems, but is also possible to overcome these protecting software and systems through hacking and various other attacks. It is possible to store the sensitive data in an encrypted as well as secretly hidden way which will double the security level as first of all the attacker would have no idea where the secret data is hidden, even if in some way the attacker may find the secret data the it will be in an encrypted format which will be of no use to them. Therefore, it is necessary to introduces more than one level of security for data security. Hence in this paper one such approach has been proposed to use more than one technique for data security simultaneously namely cryptography and steganography, both of them are very popular techniques. The former is used to encrypt the data and the later is used to hide the data, together using both of them could help in increasing the security in a better way. This paper intends to improvise the technique of data security with a combination of the above two mentioned techniques and for a more secure approach, the data will be first encrypted using a key, and this key will be generated using the Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithm and the key will be modified by key expansion, reduction and rotation techniques to increase the randomness for each round of encryption. Later this encrypted data will hidden into another image file, using the Least Significant bit steganography method by embedding encrypted data into lower order bits of the carrier image. In this paper the data hiding capacity is improved by increasing more than one least significant bits of the image and hence hence it will also reduce the number of clock cycles used for embedding and retrieving process. And the quality of the obtained output image will be benchmarked by calculating its PSNR (Peak signal to noise ratio) and MSE (Mean Square Error). The tools used for implementation are XILINX VIVADO, using verilog code for the proposed Architecture and MATLAB for image characterization and key generation.

articleTitle: Fluctuating Power Decoupling By using Symmetrical Half Bridge Circuit in Single Phase Systems
abstract: To convert DC voltages from one value to another value, DC to DC converters are used. Two such DC to DC converters are mainly available. Buck converter and boost converter. There are, furthermore, many techniques, such as mechanical, linear, capacitive, magnetic and switched mode, for these converters. In DC to DC converters, semiconductor switching components are necessary if a shift in the DC value from one level to another is required. The switches for power conversion are commonly considered as switch mode power supply (SMPS). It is expected that the DC to DC converters will work at high performance. However, due to the switching operations, a considerable amount of energy is lost and also a few harmonics which are multiples of fundamental switching frequency are added into the system. This causes pulsating nature in output DC. This pulsating DC causes power fluctuations in the load. Active power filtering method is presented in this paper for decoupling of such fluctuating power. MATLAB simulation results of filtered and post filtering along with harmonics profile are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Chipless RFID Resonators for UWB Applications
abstract: Chipless Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is one of the most rapidly increasing technologies in the field of identification of systems over the past few years. Tagging technology has an edge over the optical barcodes as it does not require line-of-sight communication. In this article, a chipless RFID tag is designed using several rectangular patches with a U-Shape and an inverted U-shaped resonator. The dimensions of the proposed tag are 19 mm x 19 mm x 1.6 mm and it is designed to operate at frequencies between 4-10 GHz. RCS simulations have been carried out using CST Microwave studio version 2019 and the results have proven to be suitable for applications in the Ultra-wideband frequency range.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Grating Structure for Enhancing the Absorbance in Organic Solar Cell
abstract: In this work the characteristics of organic solar cell (OSC) containing double grating structures has been studied. The active organic material used in OSC is PH3T:PCBM. The numerical analysis method Finite-Difference Time Domain (FDTD) is employed for design and analysis of the Grating based OSC. Based on the design parameters the structure of the OSC was analysed for double grating structure which helps in light trapping. It is observed that the absorption in active layer is nearly 65% in OSC structure with double grating structure.

articleTitle: Analytical Analysis of Figure of Merit, Nonlinearity and Self-Phase Modulation (SPM) for the Generation of 110GHz Opto-electronic Oscillator (OEO)
abstract: Presently the Optoelectronic Oscillator (OEO) has been a potential area of research due to its utility in space applications. The electro-optic modulator (EOM) based 110 GHz optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) is the potential device to be used for the space applications. This paper presents the analytical analysis of Figure of merit, nonlinear issues and Self-Phase modulation (SPM) of the EOM for the generation of 110GHz. In this study a smallest Figure of merit of electro-optic modulator (EOM) is proposed. An effect of nonlinear effective refractive index of the EOM is also discussed. The parameters such as waveguide dispersion, effective refractive index, intensity and waveguide area has been analysed to propose a suitable EOM dimension for the 110 GHz OEO. The dispersion due to Self-Phase modulation (SPM) and corresponding changes in the spectral contents has also been analysed.

Author Keywords: EOM linear and nonlinear refractive index

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Different MPPT Techniques for PV System
abstract: The following paper presents the implementation of three Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) techniques namely Perturb and Observe (P&O), Incremental Conductance (InC), and Sliding Mode Controller (SMC) approaches to track the maximum power under varying irradiation and their tracking efficiency is examined particularly on the regions where irradiation is having sharp and sudden changes. The entire simulation is done in MATLAB/Simulink. Since the classical P&O, InC methods are easy to implement and hence are widely used but due to the nonlinearity of PV systems and sudden and large changes in climatic conditions made the tracking efficiency drops to a larger extent so this system requires some nonlinear tool to overcome this shortcoming. SMC is one such nonlinear tool used in this paper for the prevention of this drastic change in tracking efficiency(TE) at the point of sudden irradiation changes and to ensure the proper tracking of maximum power and hence making the system more reliable during climatic changes. The above described methods are analysed and compared based on the different performance parameters involving ideal power, output power, TE.

articleTitle: Dialog prediction in Institute Admission: A Deep Learning Way
abstract: Chatbot, an application capable to conduct online chat conversation via test, text to speech or speech to text, giving an experience of providing direct contact to a human agent. A chatbot is designed to simulate the way a human talks / behaves during a conversation and require lots of tuning and testing to pass the turing test. Chatbots are used for various purposes like customer service, routing a request, information gathering, complaint registration, e-commerce, health, educations and many more. Chatbot domains can be categorized in two types, Open and Closed. To make a closed domain chatbot precise information, questions and their answers are needed for training. While making closed domain chatbots the amount of information is less compared to open domain. Chatbots can also be further divided into two types - retrieval based chatbots, which use predefined input patterns and predefined responses, and generative based which use seq2seq neural networks and generate a answer based on large amount of data. The required data for this chatbot is collected by a survey done with the help of Google forms and is cleaned using Python and Natural Language Tool-Kit. Classification of classes is done using various machine learning techniques such as Stochastic gradient, Sequential model, Rectified Linear activation function (ReLu), Softmax. 3 Layers of Neural Networks are used to create the model. The above mentioned models and functions give accuracy of outputs more than 90%.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of LDPC Decoding Algorithms for CCSDS Telecommand Space Data Link Protocol
abstract: This paper presents the simulation of the encoding scheme defined by CCSDS for satellite Telecommand operations and analysis of various soft decision and hard decision decoding algorithms for the same. The G(Generator), H (Parity-check) matrices are designed and verified for encoding and decoding of the message respectively. The decoding algorithms are implemented and the performances are analyzed and non-convergence of decoding algorithms, scheduling restrictions of the defined H, G matrix are explored. It is found that soft decision algorithms give 6dB coding gain and hard decision algorithms give 4 dB coding gain for the 4-bit quantized inputs.

articleTitle: Gain Enhancement of Triangular Multiband antenna using a Combination of Reactive Impedance Surface, Frequency Selective Surface and Defected Ground Structure
abstract: With the advent of modern communication technology, a device needs to be operated more than a communication standard to gratify the user requirements. This provides a path for the researcher to work more on antennas with multiband resonances. The major hindrance of multiband antennas is that the gain of the individual operating bands. In this paper presents, a design of multiband antenna and the performance is improved by a blend of three different layers called Reactive impedance surface, Frequency Selective Surface, and Defected Ground Structure. The proposed antenna resonates 3.2 GHz, 5.6 GHz, 6.5 GHz,7.2 GHz, 7.5 GHz, and 9.3 GHz with a better return loss and gain.

articleTitle: Modelling Trust Frameworks for Network-IDS
abstract: Though intrusion detection systems provide actionable alerts based on signature-based or anomaly-based traffic patterns, the majority of systems still rely on human analysts to identify and contain the root cause of security incidents. This process is naturally susceptible to human error and is time-consuming, which may allow for further enumeration and pivoting within a compromised environment. Through this paper, we have augmented traditional signature-based network intrusion detection systems with a trust framework whose reduction and redemption values are a function of the severity of the incident, the degree of connectivity of nodes and the time elapsed. A lightweight implementation on the nodes coupled with a multithreaded approach on the central trust server has shown the capability to scale to larger networks with high traffic volumes and a varying proportion of suspicious traffic patterns.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of PV Powered Water Pumping System using Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
abstract: Solar powered water pumping is one of the major applications of solar energy in remote areas. Mostly in developing countries the rural areas are not often connected with main grid hence people have to depend on standalone system for various energy needs. In remote areas supply of electricity from national grid has remained largely uncertain and out of reach as well as the price of diesel makes cultivation costly. Moreover during summer months the erratic and non-availability of power supply creates hindrance in the daily activities of rural people For water pumping purposes traditionally DC motors were used but due to easy availability of AC motors with highly efficient features and rigid construction the trend has shifted from DC motor to AC motor. Moreover among AC motors permanent magnet synchronous motor is highly efficient and available in more compact size as it includes features of both DC motor and induction otor. Use of battery also increases maintenance cost. In this paper Photovoltaic water pumping system is designed using ac motor i.e. permanent magnet synchronous motor and without battery. MATLAB/Simulink is used to carry out the research work.

articleTitle: A Single Stage Three Phase Modified Vienna Rectifier with Power Electronic Scott Connection Transformer
abstract: The need for non regenerative pulse width modulated type rectifier is increasing day by day in areas requiring unidirectional power flow. A three phase modified Vienna Rectifier based on power electronic Scott connection transformer with reduced switch count is proposed in this paper. Power electronic Scott connection transformer avail the advantage of size and weight reduction. Major advantages are: there is a single stage conversion, there is no need of intermediate bulky dc link capacitor which is not reliable, also high power density is achieved. This paper uses decoupled d-q reference frame control technique for maintaining unity power factor and to give rectified output.

articleTitle: Multi-agent based Monitoring System for Fog Computing Environment
abstract: Fog computing becomes more popular as it brings computational capabilities near to edge/Internet of Things devices to reduce the communication delay. Due to constantly expanding IoT Devices and their data, the monitoring of the fog computing environment encounters critical challenges related to scalability, efficiency, and performance. In this paper, a Multi-agent based monitoring system for the fog computing environment of proposed. Multiple intelligent agents are used to perform the various tasks of monitoring systems such as data collection, data aggregation, and decision making. The data collection model introduces a novel hybrid push-pull algorithm that updates data when the difference between updated values and new value should be greater than threshold value. A tree-based data aggregation model is developed to summarize the data which intern helps to reduce communication bandwidth between fog node and cloud. The complex event processing is used in decision making system to take control decision. Experimental evaluation shows that reduction in data coherence and bandwidth compared to existing models.

articleTitle: Novel Approach to Enhance Network Lifetime in Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Now-a-days, the importance of the Internet of Things and big data technologies is increasing day by day. It is attracting researchers towards them as it contains many challenging aspects such as unstable network structure, constantly changing network topologies, intermittent connectivity between the nodes and constrained resources. Due to these challenges, the majority of the researchers and industry persons wants to work in this area. Clustering algorithms play a significant role in the conservation of energy in a limited network. Choosing the head of the cluster Matches the load on the network correctly. This decreases energy consumption and maximizes life.

articleTitle: Modeling and Verification of Web Services Composition Using CWB-NC Tool
abstract: Modeling and verification of web services composition determines the execution flow of various web services used in conjunction. Existing techniques, such as, UML and testing are used successfully to describe the behavior of the web service system and find the bugs during the communication of the components. However, it is not always possible to identify bugs at all the stages. Formal specification and verification is an emerging technique for specifying the structural and functional property of the web service composition. Calculus of Communicating Systems (CCS) is a process-algebra used as a language for formal specification. In this article, we have utilized CCS for describing the behavioral specification of the web service system. The requirement of the system is captured through formulas or properties utilizing mu-calculus, and formally verified through Concurrency Work Bench of the New Century (CWB-NC) model checker tool.

articleTitle: Loss Minimization and Reliability Enhancement in Electrical Power Distribution Systems using Network Reconfiguration with Loss Sensitivity Factor
abstract: This paper proposes Loss Sensitivity Factor (LSF) based algorithm for reconfiguration of the network to find out the best switching combinations and to attain minimum real power loss, also enhancement in voltage and reliability. The considered Network Reconfiguration Algorithm (NRA) in this paper is verified on standard IEEE 33-bus Radial Distribution System (RDS) using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Power optimization in configurable ALU using blend of techniques
abstract: Reduction in power dissipation is an essential design issue in VLSI circuit. One of the important block in any processor is Arithmetic Logic Unit and it performs arithmetic and logical operations. If operations are more and more complex then power dissipation is more. The clock network is a major source of power dissipation so we can reduce significant amount of power if we can gate the clock whenever it isn't required. From the literature, we have noticed that there several methods/techniques used to reduce the power within ALU, the used methods are moderate and still there is scope to reduce power using blend of techniques. So low power ALU is designed using clock gating techniques besides using PIPO and Booth's algorithm concept. By giving specific opcode, we can enable the specific operation and other operations are in inactive mode, so we can see less power dissipation in ALU. Low power ALU is having two 8 bit input data with cin, bin, enable and 2 bit shift data and a decoder 4:16 to select the 16 operations by giving 4 bit opcode to it as a input with start enable_function. At each iteration the proposed design is implemented with one of these clock gating techniques i.e latch free clock gated technique, latch based clock gated technique, flipflop based clock gated technique, and synthesis based clock gating technique with parallel in parallel out (PIPO) shift registers. These all techniques are performed with operation selection feature and PIPO shift registers in this design at different operating frequencies 100MHZ, 200MHZ, 400MHZ, 500MHZ and 1GHZ in Virtex-6. Virtex-6 FPGA board having 40nm technology with 1 volt in Xilinx ISE 14.4 tool. This paper mainly focuses to analyze the dynamic power dissipation for various frequencies in ALU with and without clock gating techniques combining with PIPO and Booth's algorithm methods.

articleTitle: FDTD Analysis of Surface Plasmon Resonance Structure
abstract: Surface plasmon resonance sensor using gold thin film material simulation is carried out. The reflectance and dispersion relation in the surface plasmons resonance in the glass and gold interface is analyzed. The operating wavelength used is 500nm (visible range). SPR mode at the 500nm using FDTD mathematical modeling method gives the resonance angle at 47 degree. The perfectly matched layers and Bloch boundaries are used in the simulation of SPR sensor. Here we are analyzing the dispersion and reflectance at the glass/gold/air interface. There are two SPR modes observed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Partial PID Controller For Speed Control of Induction Motor
abstract: Induction motors discover use in a variety of places and speed control of Induction motors is a prerequisite for its utilization in such. The PID controllers are the most utilized modern input control strategy. This paper deals with the design of an adaptive partial order PID controller for the speed control of an induction motor. Adaptive partial PID controller is devised by employing soft computation tuning approaches (Particle Swarm optimization and Genetic Algorithm) on PPID controllers.

articleTitle: Classification Model Simulator: A simulator for different Machine Learning Classification Algorithms
abstract: The explosion in the use of Machine Learning increases the need for a more automated approach in order to save time, human resource and tackle the lack of skills and knowledge required in implementing the same. Amongst the various techniques, the widespread use of Machine Learning Classification in today's world has made it an important skill, but building and training models from scratch is a tedious process which requires programming skills along with in-depth knowledge of the domain. The project presents a methodology and design of an open source software to simulate four Machine Learning Classification Models for any given numeric or string based data set along with the option of pre processing the input data set and then observe the final results.

articleTitle: A Comparison between Syllabus of AICTE and various Universities - An NLP Based Approach
abstract: This paper focuses on comparative studies between the syllabus of AICTE and various Universities across India and will recommend the changes to be done so as to have holistic development. Today's generation needs to be updated with the technical world. In spite of the growing engineer population, unemployment is on the verge. This is because they have degrees but are not technically skilled. It has become necessary that engineering graduate should possess a set of skills which encompass technical skills and practical knowledge. This paper focuses on NLP based approach and lists the topics which are lagging in those universities as compared to the AICTE syllabus. It also lists the topics which are upfront and updated in those universities and together it provides the means to improve the syllabus.Each course is designed with specific Course Outcomes (COs) and each CO is mapped to the Program Outcome (PO). Hence Course Outcome attainment and mapping of Course Outcome with Program Outcome play a vital role in Outcome-based education (OBE). The attainment of Course Outcomes is quantified by assessing students. Program Outcomes need to be achieved so as to measure the attainment of a particular program. Hence, the program outcomes need to be linked properly. This paper also focuses that if a particular topic is not covered, it will show the Course Outcome not attained for that particular topic. This process will surely help in structuring the syllabus to effectively reach the desired Outcome Based Education goals. A dataset of topics for each module for various courses has been collected and processed through punctuation and stop words, tokenization, stemming, and term weighting.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning and Virtual Reality in Ophthalmology for Detection of Glaucoma
abstract: AI has the immense caliber to perform efficiently according to the industry's needs. One of the reasons is AI's image processing technology. Since ophthalmology requires the processing of images of the eyes for different eye conditions, AI is playing a significant role in the field. It has allowed the growth of “intelligent diagnosis” Through this study, a model will be proposed for the earliest detection of glaucoma using AI specifically Deep Learning (DL) and Virtual Reality (VR). This would help patients to begin treatment at the earliest stages to prevent complete loss of vision. The idea of designing this model as compared to more efficient yet complex techniques available in hospitals is because in the delay of glaucoma detection, precious time is lost and with it, irreparable damage is inflicted upon the eye. The diagnosis of glaucoma depends on the optic disc and surrounding retinal nerve fiber layer assessment performed by a trained professional. Therefore, the detection of glaucoma has always been limited in its economic value due to the precise skills required and its labor-intensive nature. Given the growing public health concern, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic, improvements towards the field of screening and diagnosis of glaucoma are endorsed. The proposed methodology would consist of a VR environment for obtaining information required like maximum peripheral distance combined with various inputs that would be taken for the DL model, an efficient and precise diagnosis would be expected which would highly cut the cost of performing expensive eyes tests.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Through Hole Via
abstract: In this Paper the design of a four layer Through-Hole Via and analysis of various parameters on its performance has projected. The designed Via resonates at 6 GHz with lower and higher cut-off frequency of 5 and 6.7 GHz respectively. Voltage Standing Wave Ratio(VSWR) of the designed Via is 1.5 which shows that impedance matched properly and produces wider band width of 29.06% with an axial ratio of 2.006. Impact of radius and height of Via, PAD and ANTI-PAD radius on its performance has also analyzed. The design and analysis is carried out through HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator)3d Electromagnetic Simulation Software.

articleTitle: Video Searching and Retrieval using Scene Classification in Multimedia Databases
abstract: Image and video indexing techniques play a key role in content-based searching in multimedia databases. A novel efficient video similarity search approach for content-based video retrieval in a large storage device is proposed. A compressed domain feature is used to classify the scenes of a video sequence. The performance of the said feature in classifying the scenes is evaluated by considering different feature lengths. Subsequently, a novel searching algorithm is proposed based on entropy of the image. This method incorporates temporal information of the video during video retrieval. Additionally, the proposed system has the facility to query both by video and by image. The 92.3% accuracy of the proposed method exceeded that of the VA-file 81.0% and OVA-file 76.4% methods and the computational complexity was lower than the VA-file method. This demonstrates the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modified Design and Implementation of Single Phase Seven Level Inverter with Different PWM Techniques
abstract: This paper presents a modified design of Single phase seven level inverter with reduced number of switches when compared to conventional multi level inverters like Neutral point clamped, Flying capacitor and cascaded. The advantage of proposed topology is having less number of components in terms of MOSFETS, gate driver circuits, compact design, short length connecting wires, less space, size, weight and cost, Thereby decreasing the switching losses, heat losses, copper losses to achieve better conversion efficiency and improved total harmonic distortion of the multilevel Inverter with different over modulation PWM techniques to control the power quality at load side. The results of proposed system with output voltage, current performances and Total Harmonic Distortions (THDs) are compared with conventional PWM technique in simulink environment.

Author Keywords: Over modulation Pulse Width Modulation technique.

articleTitle: VR Photography Embedded Map With Grid based Indoor Positioning
abstract: We propose a VR Photography embedded map construction specifically designed for the navigation of indoor places for various surrounding conditions and different terrains. A broad variety of mapping and navigation systems are unusable in indoor places due to the intricate details that are needed for navigating small places. They also fail because of inaccuracy to small distances due to not being able to map these regions. Also, navigation in these places needs location data which can distinguish position to highly smaller distances. We present a system that can construct a map of an indoor place based on its images or videos and a navigation system that can accurately help in any kind of indoor place irrespective of the surrounding. This navigation system is built on a grid based system that has a position estimator model trained with data from each block of the grid and can specifically locate the position of each such block.

articleTitle: Efficacy of NPC Technique in Approximation of Fractional Order Differentiators and Integrators
abstract: Fractional order differentiators and integrators play an important role in control and automation of physical processes. This is because fractional order Proportional-Intergral-Derivative controllers provide two additional parameters for fine tuning which in turn improves the overall system performance.
