However direct realization of fractional order differentiators and integrators is not easy, so it is first converted into an integer order function and then realized using active/passive elements. NPC is a recent approximation technique proposed in 2018 to derive rational approximation of fractional order differ-integrators. In this paper NPC based integer order models of fractional order differ-integrators are presented for all fractional powers ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 in steps of 0.1 and also for 0.25 and 0.75. The performance of the proposed models is compared with integer models developed using other existing techniques and also with ideal response. This has been done by calculating maximum magnitude and phase errors. It has been found that NPC based rational models are very much close to the ideal frequency response. To establish the correctness of NPC technique these proposed models are applied to develop integer approximation of a fractional plant model of order 0.73 and having 0.5 second delay. The step response results when compared with integer approximation model developed using other existing techniques show that NPC based model is stable and has least steady state error. These proposed models can directly be used for realization of customized fractional order Proportional-Integral, Proportional-Derivative and PID controllers. The simulations have been performed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Effective Venipuncture Method for Intravenous Therapy
abstract: Identification of Vein before venipuncture or before dosage of intravenous drugs has been a concern to prevent major health disorders. Though vein detection is possible using CMOS CDD Camera and thermal camera, cost required in use of these imagining technique is a concern. We have researched comparatively efficient method to Identify veins before venipuncture or before dosage of intravenous drugs. It is found that Modified Web Camera with NIR LED can be used to acquire image of vein. According to the study quality of images acquired using this technique is comparatively lower than that of the standard technique currently used. We can eliminate this drawback by introducing additional stages of pre-processing techniques like Adaptive histogram equalization and Contrast Stretching to enhance the quality of the image. Once the pre-processing stages is completed the acquired images can used by the physician to recognize the vein.

articleTitle: Medical Image Fusion using Lifting based Transform Techniques
abstract: Medical image fusion is the means to obtain an enhanced image with better quality and reduced redundancy by fusion of two or more images that may or may not belong to the same modalities. The imaging modalities such as Magnetic Imaging Resonance (MRI), Computed Tomography (CT), Positron Emission Tomography (PET), Single Positron Emission Tomography (SPECT) etc have found their application in diagnosis in the medical domain. The paper presents the use of these imaging modalities pairs (MRI-T1/T2; MRI-PET/ SPECT) to perform medical fusion in transform domain. The paper presents two approaches. 1) It uses the lifting step-based wavelet transform (LWT), a better algorithm that takes significantly less computational time, does distortion-free reconstruction for the Average-Max, Edge-Energy fusion rules. 2) It proposes the new fusion rule to obtain an improved fused image. The fusion rule is applied using the DWT and LWT, and comparisons are made accordingly on the image pairs. Entropy, Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), and average gradient are used as performance metrics to assess the image quality.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Universal Gates based on the Comparative Factors of Delay Propagation, Average Power Dissipation and Logical Effort
abstract: This paper illustrates the practical/working difference between the universal logic gates- NAND & NOR. The comparative analysis of the universal gates has been carried out, based on the parameters of delay, Fan-out and power consumption. The design and simulations are performed using Cadence Virtuoso tool in 45nm CMOS technology. The simulation results are in agreement to the literature presented regarding the logical effort of the gates. Here, the power dissipation and the delay calculations lead to conclusive results which are extensively discussed in this paper. The comparative assessment implemented for the gates is performed with same technology and same circuit designing techniques. Further, this work provides a decisive comment on- which amongst the two universal gates is more efficient for CMOS design.

articleTitle: SOSF Implemented Single Stage Solar PV Fed Grid Integrated Water Pumping System Driven Through PMS Motor
abstract: The impetus behind proposing this method to give a robust and cost-effective system with improved power quality for solar water pumping as harmonics are an unavoidable concern of power and efficiency, attracting more and more attention with the rapid growth of electronic power technologies. The topology deployed for single stage water pumping system endowed Solar PV array involves a solar PV array, 3-phase VSI (Voltage Source Inverter), PMS (Permanent Magnet Synchronous) Motor, VSC (Voltage Source Converter), Utility grid and a centrifugal pump. The water pumping system supplied through solar PV does not demand very fast dynamic response, hence single stage topology is more beneficial. The motive is to makes the system tractable and cost effective. The electrical power supplies by the solar PV is enhanced and optimised by adopting PO (Perturb & Observe) MPP tracking. Integrating to grid makes incessant water pumping with varying solar irradiance too. The VSC control is done by UVT (Unit Vectors Templates) mechanism, where SOSF (Second Order Sequence Filter) is used for the grid voltage filtering purpose, as VSC used for the process of rectification and inversion. The PMS motor is controlled through VCT (Vector Control Theory) for controlling the speed. The demonstrated systems outcomes are modelled and visualized under consistent and changing irradiation levels using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Negative Sequence based Fault Discrimination Technique for Shunt Compensated Transmission Line
abstract: Power demand during the past few years has increased enormously due to the population growth and usage of their electrical appliances. To fulfill the customer needs without any disturbances in power flow, we opt FACTS devices in the transmission line. Among the FACTS devices, STATCOM (a shunt controller) is generally used to inject current into the system at the point of common coupling(PCC) to enhance the voltage at that point. Based on the phase angle between injected current and voltage at the point of common coupling, the STATCOM supplies/consumes real and reactive power to/from the system. Due to the presence of a shunt controller, the distance based relays may operate in Under-reach/Over-reach modes depending on the mode of operation of the shunt controller (Capacitive/Inductive). This feature of the STATCOM may cause trouble if a fault occurs in the system. To overcome this, both end negative sequence current data of the system is used in this proposed method to differentiate the mode of STATCOM and also fault type (External/Internal). The proposed logic is evaluated in MATLAB/SIMULINK software and it is producing appropriate results.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement and Comparative Analysis of Memristive Emulator Networks
abstract: This paper reviews and analyzes a memristive emulator network based on mosfets and accordingly its design and operating parameters are optimized for enhanced performance. The Double Hysteresis Loop phenomenon, a unique feature of memristors/memristive systems is seen in the improved circuit. Parametric analysis for various operating parameters like input voltage, frequency, temperature is performed along with the calculation of average dynamic power and static power requirements of the circuit. A comparative study with another transistor-based memristor circuit is also carried out. The possible applications of this memristive circuit are also proposed in the paper. All the proposed designs and simulation results are performed using Cadence Virtuoso ADE $180\mathrm{n}\mathrm{m}$ technology.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Variation of Load and Placement of Generator in Power System Incorporating FACTS
abstract: In the recent years the demand inelectrical power increased exponentially, while power generation and transmission have been limited due to economic reasons and environmental reasons which increase the complexity of the system. The only solution is use of the Flexible AC transmission system (FACTS) it has a characteristics of controllability over the efficiency, reliability and flexibility. It is best over other conventional control method. The modeling and simulation of the unified power flow controller (UPFC) for power system stability and improve in power transfer capability. The UPFC is used to control the power by varying the impedance and voltage magnitude. The paper compares the voltage regulation by varying the load and placement of the generator with and without FACTS Device (i.e UPFC). The total Harmonic distortion is tabulated with and without FACTS device and fault analysis with and without the FACTS. The study is carried out on IEEE 3 BUS system, in MATLAB simulink; codes are used using load flow analysis algorithm. Results are tabulated, studied and compared. Voltage regulation is also determined by changing the placement of the generator, and compared with UPFC and without UPFC.

articleTitle: Estimating Savings Potential of Solar Energy
abstract: The climatic conditions in India are among the best that can be used maximise solar energy potential and are capable enough to make solar energy serve the purpose as an alternative source of electricity to Thermal and Hydro electricity. However, the high installation costs of the solar panel coupled has prevented solar energy growth in the country. But when looked at from a broader perspective, solar energy can decrease the costs for electricity as well as help to reduce the adverse effects of using non-renewable energy resources like Thermal electricity. The proposed system determines a mechanism to estimate the amount of savings that an individual could make by using a solar panel on their rooftop. Deep Learning is applied to process and segment the rooftop images while removing obstructions such as trees, electric poles etc. and estimate the area of the rooftop. The solar radiation values and weather patterns of a region are considered and the calculated area is used to predict the amount of energy that can be produced by installing a solar panel on the roof.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Implementation and Cost Minimization for Retail Industry
abstract: The fossil-fuel based energy generation has many constraints, including the rising cost as well as the effects on the environment. The demand for implementing renewable energy, therefore, has risen. This paper proposes dealing with installing the battery capability system on retail sites by setting up a virtual power plant. It is preferable that the batteries are grid-connected and potentially linked to solar photovoltaic (PV). The virtual power plant with the grid-connected solar PV system will work towards meeting the changing load demands. Also, the paper considers utilizing the excess energy in the grid after meeting the load demand at the retail sites to operate ultra-fast charging points for the electric vehicles. It will charge the battery quicker in terms of the conventional battery charging structure. Three approaches have been considered, which are- grid-connected PV with battery storage system, grid-connected battery storage system without PV modules and just a battery storage system. Besides, future aspects of the paper, such as ultra-fast charging and Vehicle to Home (V2H) and Vehicle to Grid (V2G) technologies are also explored. This paper focused on the analysis and calculation of the installation cost which is estimated at around $ 25,000, annual savings of $ 2920 and payback period of the system is calculated to be around 9 years, which showed the feasibility of the virtual plant.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Active filter for IRNSS Receiver
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) is a constellation of satellites that provide autonomous geo-spatial positioning with global coverage. It allows electronic receivers to determine their location within a few meters using time signals transmitted along a line-of-sight by radio from satellites. For Indian geographical regions, IRNSS (Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System) or Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC) is an Indian navigation satellite system. We have developed IRNSS front end receiver, which includes the selection of the optimum architecture of amplifier and active filter. This paper proposes the efficient design of an operational amplifier(op-amp) with 20dB gain(G) and 40MHz bandwidth(BW) and band pass active filter with $5MHzBW(f_{L}=332KHz, f_{h}=5MHz$ with $f_{c}=1.3MHz$) for IRNSS receiver. All circuits and layout are designed by using Cadence Virtuoso software with the SBClSh2 Bi-CMOS process.

articleTitle: Single Junction Highly Efficient Perovskite Solar Cells With Sun-Light Tracking System
abstract: Perovskite materials as the sunlight-receiving layer in photovoltaic devices have resulted in high short circuit current density (Jsc) along with almost 15% energy conversion efficiency (ECE). The charge transportation layer, absorption layer materials, and their thickness have an important influence on device funtioning parameters. Here, a single layer photons absorbing perovskite material CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PI<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is used which bandgap is 1. 55eV along with a solitary axis sun-light tracking function is integrated. In this investigation, the rays of the sun are utilized by photovoltaic-panels most effectively as a solar tracking mechanism adjusts the photovoltaic-panels to the direction where sun-light beat down vertical on the earth. The device's efficiency has been improved by using an Electron Transport Layer (ETL) of aluminum-doped Zinc Oxide (AZO) and a Hole Transport Layer (HTL) of NiO. A systematic study is conducted in order to provide a comprehensive recommendation for single-junction highly effective perovskite solar cells with their optical properties integrated into sun-tracking devices. So, the solar panel can absorb energy to a maximum extent in a cost-efficient way.

articleTitle: Adaptive Equalization and Pilot Estimation in Shallow Water Environment using COFDM System for Image Transmission
abstract: It is indeed a challenge in various scientific and military applications to achieve adequate image transmission over Under Water Acoustic Communication (UWAC) in Shallow waters. In Underwater, the environment restricts signal propagation due to its limited bandwidth and multipath delay spread. This paper presents a comprehensive UWAC channel model to reliably predict the multipath effect, using COFDM system in Shallow water environments for image transmission. Secondly, numerous adaptive channel equalization algorithms, namely DFE, NLMS, FELMS and FxLMS were implemented for identifying each COFDM block data at the receiver. Comb type pilot channel estimation was also implemented using various interpolation methods like FFT, linear, Spline, and Cubic Spline techniques for the channel model with a time-varying multipath effect. The COFDM system was using a mat lab simulation environment, and its BER performance is evaluated. From the comparison results, it can be inferred that pilot tone estimation has achieved better BER performance than other adaptive equalization schemes used in the present work. FFT pilot tone channel estimation achieves 0.00012 BER value comparing to other methods at 18dB SNR value. DFE adaptive equalization scheme achieves better BER performance than other equalization schemes considered in this work.

Author Keywords: Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (COFDM) system

articleTitle: Flight Formation of multiple Rotor-craft through Co-ordination flying
abstract: Coordinate flying of drones or unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs) is one of the most intricate and vital techniques that many researchers are trying to solve. Drones flying in coordination can be used in many applications such as the military, rescue operations, package delivery and many more. Coordination flying of drones can expand a single drone's task coverage radius and also enhance the success rate of task execution. In this paper, we address the challenges faced in the coordination and communication of two parallel drones flying in coordination and also the methods we are using to overcome this difficulty.

articleTitle: A Novel 8.5 GHz Parallel Coupled, Half Wavelength Bandpass Filter with Dumbbell-Shaped Defected Ground Structure
abstract: A novel 8.5 GHz parallel coupled bandpass filter is presented with dumbbell shaped defected ground structure which is placed in the ground plane. The circuit structure is simulated using ADS. The microstrip filter structure is analyzed by gradient variation of the line that passes through the midpoints of the conducting strips, which is varied linearly with different values of slope. The effects on the bandwidth and cut-off frequency are observed to understand the desired gradient for different uses of the linear bandpass filter. The measured and analyzed results are in good agreement with the theoretical results. The proposed structure has compact size, good bandwidth, and high cut off frequency.

articleTitle: Multiplier-less Lifting-based Photo Core Transform for JPEG XR Ultrasound Image Compression
abstract: The new standard of the JPEG community, called the JPEG XR, carries the features of its earlier standards, namely the JPEG Baseline and the JPEG 2000. JPEG Baseline and JPEG 2000 have been in extensive use since their introduction; and have pre-defined tools in various platforms, such as MATLAB, for simulation and testing purposes. However, the same doesn't apply to the latest JPEG XR standard and thus creates a barrier in the ease of use for the global community. JPEG XR employs photo core transform for still-image compression, and in this paper, we propose a novel software implantation of the forward and the inverse photo core transform, PCT and IPCT respectively. The implementations are lifting-based operations that can be made multiplier-less for hardware simplicity.

articleTitle: Chattering Free Non-Singular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Controller Design for Robot Manipulator
abstract: This Paper presents a chattering free non-singular fast terminal sliding mode controller for a Robot manipulator in the presence of parameter uncertainties and external disturbances and comparison of its response with Conventional Sliding Mode Control(SMC) & Terminal Sliding Mode Control(TSMC). Non-singular Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control(NFTSMC) removes the singularity and slower convergence rate problem of Terminal Sliding Mode Control. Chattering is alleviated by applying the Super Twisting algorithm with NFTSMC without affecting tracking performance. The Effectiveness of the Controller is validated by simulation results.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Different Types of modulation in Optical Communication
abstract: This paper provides a short review on different types of modulation published in open literature by different authors and re-evaluate the performance of the commonly used modulation techniques such as Phase Shift Keying (PSK), Differential Phase Shift Keying(D-PSK), Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) in optical communication system. The QAM performs better among these modulation schemes in terms of Bit Error Rate (BER).The environment of different modulation techniques in optical communication has been created using Opti-system software followed by description of typical systems and corresponding performance evaluation. This study will provide a guide to choose an appropriate modulation scheme for optical communication.

articleTitle: Junction Based Angular Routing in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANET)
abstract: Junction Based Angular routing (JBAR) is devised exclusively for use in the vehicular adaptable infrastructure. JBAR is an oblique junction-based topographical routing which originates concise pathway from an initiator to target knob. The pathway construction is carried out in three stages - (i) Initiator track the locality of target and interceder knobs. (ii) Enumerates the angle of deflection of the interceder knobs from an initiator to target knob. (iii) Constitute the pathway for dispatching the message to target knob. JBAR is a class of perceptive routing in which the messages are delegated in the midway of initiator to target knobs by accomplishing opaque incline beside initiator as well as target knob by avoiding dispatch of packets over exhaustive range. Oblique junction routine overcomes communication loading in the heterogeneous vehicular infrastructure.

Author Keywords: Global Positioning System and Perceptive Routing

articleTitle: Generalized Energy-based Spectrum Sensing: Active Threshold Correction Under Noise Uncertainty
abstract: In this paper, we propose an active threshold correction (ATC) for the generalized energy detector (GED) under spectrum sensing to alleviate the effects of noise variance uncertainty (NVU) and fading. First, we derive the probability of false alarm and the probability of detection for GED, with an arbitrary exponent, assuming that the test statistic follows a gamma distribution and under Nakagami-m fading. Next, we present the effect of NVU on the performance of GED. Later, we derive an analytic expression for the corresponding ATC under NVU and Nakagami-m fading. Through numerical method, we show that by employing the ATC, the performance of GED improves in the presence of NVU and fading. Moreover, in the considered setup for GED, we show that the GED outperforms the energy detector.

articleTitle: Product Recommendation using User Preference and Online Opinion Reviews
abstract: This paper focuses on product recommendation using user preference and online opinion mining. Multiple features of a product are analyzed to get user specific product. In this paper we have analyzed user review data of mobiles sold in online markets and then predicted the most suitable mobile for the user based on preference list provided by the user. To analyze the review, the textual data is processed in multiple stages like preprocessing, feature extraction, categorizing reviews based on features, and then predicting the polarity of the review data using several machines learning model like Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, Naive Bayes Classifier and Multi-Layer Perceptron Classifier. After this user entered preferences are analyzed to give user specific products.

articleTitle: Analytical Modeling and Design of Micro Ring Modulator
abstract: Silicon photonics circuits with ring and bus waveguides are of interesting topics. The modelling of the ring modulator is analyzed in this work. The modulators are very important unit of the communication system. Simulating these structures require more time and longer propagation lengths. The 2.5D finite difference time domain also called variational FDTD is used to simulate the ring modulator. Ring modulator modal response is analyzed and the wavelength used is in the Conventional band. The Conventional band wavelength is from 1530 nm to 1565 nm band in optical communication systems. The micro ring modulator structure has effective index of 1.244672 and group index of 1.557. Transfer electric mode is used for the analysis.

articleTitle: Voltage Reliability Improvement of Grid Connected Three Phase Induction Motor
abstract: Induction motor is robust and simple in construction; it can operate in any environment condition so induction motor is a reliable choice in industry for electromechanical device. They found a wide range of application due to its durable design, low maintenance cost and wide range of load carrying capacity. As the application of induction motor in industry is increasingly widespread, it is very important to use floating H Bridge convertors to challenge and solve the problem related grid connected induction motor. Textile mills, compressors and hundreds of fans are common industrial applications of induction motor. Motor starting on heavy load or poor grid system can causes damage to induction motor as well as fluctuation of voltage. Under no load condition or steady operating condition induction motor draws reactive lagging current which varies the grid voltage that reduces motor operating efficiency. This paper contains floating capacitor H bridge convertor as series voltage compensation to improve steady state operation as well as efficiency of induction motor by controlling the motor voltage above and below the grid voltage so it is possible to achieve improved operating lifetime expectancy. In simulation, proposed method is introduced and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Resting-State Functional Connectivity Analysis for diagnosis of Epilepsy patients
abstract: Resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI) was firstly characterized by Biswal et al [1] in the year 1995 and since then it is used for studying patients with various neurosurgical, neurologic, and other brain-related disorders. Various statistical methods are used to analyze the resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging connectivity. This paper attempts to explore more on the learning of resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging connectivity. This study will help to understand the usage of rsfMRI to evaluate functional connectivity in the human brain and its usage for surgical decision-making for drug-resistant epilepsy. This paper explains the significance of such connectivity analysis, the methods available for it, and the shortcomings associated with the data.

articleTitle: Power Management of Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid in Grid Connected and Islanded Conditions
abstract: The objective of this paper is to reconstitute control switching to suffer minimal transients in the microgrid. The microgrid can be meant for the client to satisfy their needs and requirements; for example, improving local reliability, minimizing feeder losses, supporting local voltages, enhancing utilization by using waste heat, tension decrease or continuous power supply. The proposed scheme maintains a constant DC bus voltage with a consistent and efficient power distribution. The transients in the scheme are controlled by the supercapacitor because of a variation in load or source energy. This reduces the battery stress. And hence the proposed system is analyzed by MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Modified Approach to Sleep Scheduling Mechanism Using Particle Swarm Optimization for Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are powered by batteries and hence there is a need to prolong their lifetime by low power consumption. This paper proposes a modified approach to Sleep Scheduling Mechanism with Particle Swarm Optimization (MSSM-PSO) in wireless sensor networks. The redundant nodes, determined by computing the network coverage, are scheduled into hibernation state. Simulation results show that this approach reduces the energy consumption of the nodes while ensuring sufficient coverage.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of FinFET using Gate Stack and Workfunction Engineering in 14nm Technology
